declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Reference\Model\Resolver;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterfaceFactory;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Magento\Framework\AuthorizationInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\CouldNotSaveException;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\NoSuchEntityException;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Config\Element\Field;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Exception\GraphQlAuthorizationException;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Exception\GraphQlInputException;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Exception\GraphQlNoSuchEntityException;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Query\ResolverInterface;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Schema\Type\ResolveInfo;

/**
 * Mutations createAcmeReferenceItem and updateAcmeReferenceItem (one resolver, the "id" argument
 * tells them apart).
 *
 * Pattern: authorize first (ACL of the admin/integration token); copy only the fields that came in
 * (update keeps the others, see ItemRepository::save); translate domain exceptions into the GraphQL
 * ones the client understands.
 */
class SaveItem implements ResolverInterface
{
    public const ACL_RESOURCE = 'Acme_Reference::item_save';

    /**
     * @param AuthorizationInterface $authorization
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     * @param ItemInterfaceFactory $itemFactory
     * @param ItemFormatter $formatter
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuthorizationInterface $authorization,
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository,
        private readonly ItemInterfaceFactory $itemFactory,
        private readonly ItemFormatter $formatter
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function resolve(Field $field, $context, ResolveInfo $info, ?array $value = null, ?array $args = null)
    {
        if (!$this->authorization->isAllowed(self::ACL_RESOURCE)) {
            throw new GraphQlAuthorizationException(__('The current user is not allowed to save items.'));
        }
        $input = (array)($args['input'] ?? []);
        $id = isset($args['id']) ? (int)$args['id'] : null;
        if ($id === null && (empty($input['code']) || empty($input['name']))) {
            throw new GraphQlInputException(__('"code" and "name" are required to create an item.'));
        }

        $item = $this->itemFactory->create();
        if ($id !== null) {
            $item->setId($id);
        }
        if (isset($input['code'])) {
            $item->setCode((string)$input['code']);
        }
        if (isset($input['name'])) {
            $item->setName((string)$input['name']);
        }
        if (isset($input['status'])) {
            $item->setStatus((int)$input['status']);
        }
        if (array_key_exists('price', $input)) {
            $item->setPrice($input['price'] === null ? null : (float)$input['price']);
        }
        if (array_key_exists('valid_from', $input)) {
            $item->setValidFrom($input['valid_from'] === null ? null : (string)$input['valid_from']);
        }
        if (array_key_exists('description', $input)) {
            $item->setDescription($input['description'] === null ? null : (string)$input['description']);
        }

        try {
            return $this->formatter->format($this->itemRepository->save($item));
        } catch (NoSuchEntityException $e) {
            throw new GraphQlNoSuchEntityException(__('No item with id %1.', $id), $e);
        } catch (CouldNotSaveException $e) {
            throw new GraphQlInputException(__('%1', $e->getMessage()), $e);
        }
    }
}

{
    /**
     * @param Config $config
     * @param ItemSavedPublisher $publisher

        private readonly Config $config,
        private readonly ItemSavedPublisher $publisher
    ) {
    }

            $this->publisher->publish((int)$item->getId());
        }
    }
}

use Magento\Framework\Event\Observer;

use Magento\Sales\Api\Data\OrderInterface;
use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;

/**
 * Observer of a core event (sales_order_place_after). Runs inside the checkout request: never call
 * external services or send e-mail here; log, flag or publish to a queue. Never throw: an exception
 * here breaks the customer's order placement.
 */
class OrderPlacedObserver implements ObserverInterface
{
    /**
     * @param LoggerInterface $logger the module's own log file (virtualType in etc/di.xml)
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly LoggerInterface $logger
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param Observer $observer
     * @return void
     */
    public function execute(Observer $observer): void
    {
        $order = $observer->getEvent()->getData('order');
        if (!$order instanceof OrderInterface) {
            return;
        }
        $note = method_exists($order, 'getData') ? $order->getData('acme_reference_note') : null;
        if ($note !== null && $note !== '') {
            $this->logger->info('Order placed with delivery note', [
                'order' => $order->getIncrementId(),
                'note_length' => strlen((string)$note),
            ]);
        }
    }
}

use Magento\Checkout\Block\Checkout\LayoutProcessor;

/**
 * Adds a field to the checkout shipping address form (jsLayout), declared in etc/frontend/di.xml.
 *
 * The value travels with the shipping information: the JS mixin
 * view/frontend/web/js/action/set-shipping-information-mixin.js moves it from custom_attributes
 * to extension_attributes, ShippingInformationManagementPlugin stores it on the quote, and
 * etc/fieldset.xml copies it to the order.
 *
 * Pattern: check that the path exists (virtual carts and one-step checkouts change the tree);
 * template and elementTmpl are real Magento_Ui templates, never invented names (C3).
 */
class LayoutProcessorPlugin
{
    /**
     * @param LayoutProcessor $subject
     * @param array $jsLayout
     * @return array
     */
    public function afterProcess(LayoutProcessor $subject, array $jsLayout): array
    {
        $steps = $jsLayout['components']['checkout']['children']['steps']['children'] ?? [];
        if (!isset($steps['shipping-step']['children']['shippingAddress']['children']['shipping-address-fieldset'])) {
            return $jsLayout;
        }
        $jsLayout['components']['checkout']['children']['steps']['children']['shipping-step']['children']
        ['shippingAddress']['children']['shipping-address-fieldset']['children']['acme_reference_note'] = [
            'component' => 'Magento_Ui/js/form/element/abstract',
            'config' => [
                'customScope' => 'shippingAddress.custom_attributes',
                'template' => 'ui/form/field',
                'elementTmpl' => 'ui/form/element/input',
            ],
            'provider' => 'checkoutProvider',
            'dataScope' => 'shippingAddress.custom_attributes.acme_reference_note',
            'label' => __('Delivery note'),
            'sortOrder' => 250,
            'validation' => ['max_text_length' => 255],
            'visible' => true,
        ];

use Magento\Checkout\Api\Data\ShippingInformationInterface;

use Magento\Quote\Api\CartRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Stores the checkout note on the quote before the shipping information is saved.
 *
 * Pattern: plug into the interface (the guest endpoint converts the masked id and calls this same
 * interface, so one plugin covers guests and customers); the original $cartId is untyped, so the
 * plugin keeps it untyped; the quote repository caches the active quote, so the data set here is
 * persisted by the original method's own save.
 */
class ShippingInformationManagementPlugin
{
    /**
     * @param CartRepositoryInterface $cartRepository
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly CartRepositoryInterface $cartRepository
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param ShippingInformationManagementInterface $subject
     * @param int|string $cartId
     * @param ShippingInformationInterface $addressInformation
     * @return null keeps the original arguments
     */
    public function beforeSaveAddressInformation(
        ShippingInformationManagementInterface $subject,
        $cartId,
        ShippingInformationInterface $addressInformation
    ) {
        $extension = $addressInformation->getShippingAddress()?->getExtensionAttributes();
        $note = $extension?->getAcmeReferenceNote();
        if ($note !== null) {
            $quote = $this->cartRepository->getActive((int)$cartId);
            $quote->setData('acme_reference_note', mb_substr(trim((string)$note), 0, 255));
        }
        return null;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Reference\Plugin;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\LocalizedException;

/**
 * The three plugin kinds in one class, on a service contract (declared in etc/di.xml under
 * <type name="Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface">).
 *
 * Rules:
 * - plug into an interface of the public API, on public methods; never on final, static or
 *   __construct, and prefer a plugin to a <preference> that replaces a core class;
 * - before{Method}: receives the original arguments, returns them as an array (or null to keep);
 * - around{Method}: only when you must decide whether the original runs. Call $proceed with the
 *   arguments and ALWAYS return its result (or throw). It costs a frame on every call: prefer
 *   before/after when they solve it;
 * - after{Method}: receives the result first, then the original arguments; returns the result;
 * - the first parameter is always $subject, typed with the plugged class or interface;
 * - argument types must match the original method: setup:di:compile rejects a mismatch.
 */
class ItemRepositoryPlugin
{
    /**
     * Codes starting with this prefix belong to the system and cannot be deleted.
     */
    public const PROTECTED_PREFIX = 'SYSTEM_';

    /**
     * Before: normalize the code before any save (admin, REST, GraphQL and imports all pass here).
     *
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $subject
     * @param ItemInterface $item
     * @return array
     */
    public function beforeSave(ItemRepositoryInterface $subject, ItemInterface $item): array
    {
        if ($item->getCode() !== null) {
            $item->setCode(strtoupper(trim($item->getCode())));
        }
        return [$item];
    }

    /**
     * Around: decides whether the original runs (protected items are never deleted).
     *
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $subject
     * @param callable $proceed
     * @param int $itemId
     * @return bool
     * @throws LocalizedException
     */
    public function aroundDeleteById(ItemRepositoryInterface $subject, callable $proceed, int $itemId): bool
    {
        $item = $subject->getById($itemId);
        if (str_starts_with((string)$item->getCode(), self::PROTECTED_PREFIX)) {
            throw new LocalizedException(
                __('The item "%1" is protected and cannot be deleted.', $item->getCode())
            );
        }
        return $proceed($itemId);
    }

    /**
     * After: completes the result (an item without name shows its code).
     *
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $subject
     * @param ItemInterface $result
     * @param int $itemId
     * @return ItemInterface
     */
    public function afterGetById(ItemRepositoryInterface $subject, ItemInterface $result, int $itemId): ItemInterface
    {
        if ((string)$result->getName() === '' && $result->getCode() !== null) {
            $result->setName($result->getCode());
        }
        return $result;
    }
}

namespace Acme\Reference\Plugin\Sales;

use Magento\Framework\DataObject;
use Magento\Sales\Api\Data\OrderExtensionFactory;
use Magento\Sales\Api\Data\OrderInterface;
use Magento\Sales\Api\Data\OrderSearchResultInterface;
use Magento\Sales\Api\OrderRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Plugin on a CORE service contract: exposes sales_order.acme_reference_note as the extension
 * attribute declared in etc/extension_attributes.xml (REST GET /V1/orders/:id shows it under
 * extension_attributes).
 *
 * Pattern: fill the attribute in afterGet AND afterGetList (lists do not call get()); keep the
 * existing extension object, since other modules fill it too; an after plugin may omit the
 * original arguments it does not use.
 */
class OrderRepositoryPlugin
{
    /**
     * @param OrderExtensionFactory $extensionFactory generated by Magento from the interface name
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly OrderExtensionFactory $extensionFactory
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param OrderRepositoryInterface $subject
     * @param OrderInterface $result
     * @return OrderInterface
     */
    public function afterGet(OrderRepositoryInterface $subject, OrderInterface $result): OrderInterface
    {
        $this->addNote($result);
        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * @param OrderRepositoryInterface $subject
     * @param OrderSearchResultInterface $result
     * @return OrderSearchResultInterface
     */
    public function afterGetList(
        OrderRepositoryInterface $subject,
        OrderSearchResultInterface $result
    ): OrderSearchResultInterface {
        foreach ($result->getItems() as $order) {
            $this->addNote($order);
        }
        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * @param OrderInterface $order
     * @return void
     */
    private function addNote(OrderInterface $order): void
    {
        $extension = $order->getExtensionAttributes() ?? $this->extensionFactory->create();
        $note = $order instanceof DataObject ? $order->getData('acme_reference_note') : null;
        $extension->setAcmeReferenceNote($note === null ? null : (string)$note);
        $order->setExtensionAttributes($extension);
    }
}

/**
 * Customer attribute shown in the admin customer form and in the storefront account forms.
 *
 * Pattern: CustomerSetupFactory (not EavSetupFactory) for customers; the attribute must be placed
 * in the default attribute set and group, and "used_in_forms" saved through the customer
 * attribute resource, otherwise it exists in the database but appears in no form.
 * The attribute is looked up by its CODE (a constant), never by its label (C10).
 */
class AddCustomerAttribute implements DataPatchInterface, PatchRevertableInterface
{
    public const ATTRIBUTE_CODE = 'acme_reference_segment';

    /**
     * @param ModuleDataSetupInterface $moduleDataSetup
     * @param CustomerSetupFactory $customerSetupFactory
     * @param AttributeSetFactory $attributeSetFactory
     * @param AttributeResource $attributeResource
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ModuleDataSetupInterface $moduleDataSetup,
        private readonly CustomerSetupFactory $customerSetupFactory,
        private readonly AttributeSetFactory $attributeSetFactory,
        private readonly AttributeResource $attributeResource
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function apply(): self
    {
        $customerSetup = $this->customerSetupFactory->create(['setup' => $this->moduleDataSetup]);
        $customerSetup->addAttribute(Customer::ENTITY, self::ATTRIBUTE_CODE, [
            'type' => 'varchar',
            'label' => 'Reference Segment',
            'input' => 'text',
            'required' => false,
            'visible' => true,
            'user_defined' => true,
            'system' => false,
            'position' => 900,
            'is_used_in_grid' => true,
            'is_visible_in_grid' => true,
            'is_filterable_in_grid' => true,
            'is_searchable_in_grid' => true,
        ]);

        $entityType = $customerSetup->getEavConfig()->getEntityType(Customer::ENTITY);
        $attributeSetId = (int)$entityType->getDefaultAttributeSetId();
        $attributeGroupId = (int)$this->attributeSetFactory->create()->getDefaultGroupId($attributeSetId);

        $attribute = $customerSetup->getEavConfig()->getAttribute(Customer::ENTITY, self::ATTRIBUTE_CODE);
        $attribute->addData([
            'attribute_set_id' => $attributeSetId,
            'attribute_group_id' => $attributeGroupId,
            'used_in_forms' => ['adminhtml_customer', 'customer_account_create', 'customer_account_edit'],
        ]);
        $this->attributeResource->save($attribute);
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function revert(): void
    {
        $customerSetup = $this->customerSetupFactory->create(['setup' => $this->moduleDataSetup]);
        $customerSetup->removeAttribute(CustomerMetadataInterface::ENTITY_TYPE_CUSTOMER, self::ATTRIBUTE_CODE);
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public static function getDependencies(): array
    {
        return [];
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function getAliases(): array
    {
        return [];
    }
}

use Magento\Framework\Exception\NoSuchEntityException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\MockObject\MockObject;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * Covers the partial update (C9): saving an item with an id keeps the fields it did not send.
 * Models are built with createPartialMock(Model::class, []) (no constructor): set the id field name
 * that _init() would set. Generated factories (ItemFactory) are created by the unit test bootstrap.
 */
class ItemRepositoryTest extends TestCase
{
    /**
     * @var ItemResource|MockObject
     */
    private ItemResource|MockObject $resource;

    /**
     * @var ItemFactory|MockObject
     */
    private ItemFactory|MockObject $itemFactory;

    /**
     * @var ItemRepository
     */
    private ItemRepository $repository;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->resource = $this->createMock(ItemResource::class);
        $this->itemFactory = $this->createMock(ItemFactory::class);
        $this->repository = new ItemRepository(
            $this->resource,
            $this->itemFactory,
            $this->createMock(CollectionFactory::class),
            $this->createMock(ItemSearchResultsInterfaceFactory::class),
            $this->createMock(CollectionProcessorInterface::class)
        );
    }

    public function testSaveWithIdKeepsTheFieldsThatWereNotSent(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->createPartialMock(Item::class, []);
        $existing->setIdFieldName('item_id');
        $existing->setData(['item_id' => 5, 'code' => 'OLD', 'name' => 'Old name', 'price' => '10.0000']);
        $this->itemFactory->method('create')->willReturn($existing);
        $this->resource->method('load')->willReturnCallback(fn() => $this->resource);

        $incoming = $this->createPartialMock(Item::class, []);
        $incoming->setIdFieldName('item_id');
        $incoming->setData(['item_id' => 5, 'name' => 'New name']);

        $saved = $this->repository->save($incoming);

        $this->assertSame('New name', $saved->getName());
        $this->assertSame('OLD', $saved->getCode());
        $this->assertSame(10.0, $saved->getPrice());
    }

    public function testGetByIdThrowsWhenTheItemDoesNotExist(): void
    {
        $empty = $this->createPartialMock(Item::class, []);
        $empty->setIdFieldName('item_id');
        $this->itemFactory->method('create')->willReturn($empty);

        $this->expectException(NoSuchEntityException::class);
        $this->repository->getById(404);
    }
}

namespace Acme\Reference\Test\Unit\Plugin;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Plugin\ItemRepositoryPlugin;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\LocalizedException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\MockObject\MockObject;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * Unit test pattern: the path mirrors the class (Test/Unit/Plugin/ItemRepositoryPluginTest.php);
 * every property is DECLARED (dynamic properties are deprecated in PHP 8.2 and the Magento unit
 * bootstrap turns the deprecation into an error); mock interfaces, not concrete classes; one
 * behaviour per test, named after it.
 */
class ItemRepositoryPluginTest extends TestCase
{
    /**
     * @var ItemRepositoryPlugin
     */
    private ItemRepositoryPlugin $plugin;

    /**
     * @var ItemRepositoryInterface|MockObject
     */
    private ItemRepositoryInterface|MockObject $subject;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->plugin = new ItemRepositoryPlugin();
        $this->subject = $this->createMock(ItemRepositoryInterface::class);
    }

    public function testBeforeSaveNormalizesTheCode(): void
    {
        $item = $this->createMock(ItemInterface::class);
        $item->method('getCode')->willReturn('  abc_1 ');
        $item->expects($this->once())->method('setCode')->with('ABC_1');

        $this->assertSame([$item], $this->plugin->beforeSave($this->subject, $item));
    }

    public function testAroundDeleteByIdBlocksProtectedItems(): void
    {
        $item = $this->createMock(ItemInterface::class);
        $item->method('getCode')->willReturn(ItemRepositoryPlugin::PROTECTED_PREFIX . 'DEFAULT');
        $this->subject->method('getById')->with(7)->willReturn($item);
        $proceedCalled = false;
        $proceed = function () use (&$proceedCalled): bool {
            $proceedCalled = true;
            return true;
        };

        $this->expectException(LocalizedException::class);
        try {
            $this->plugin->aroundDeleteById($this->subject, $proceed, 7);
        } finally {
            $this->assertFalse($proceedCalled, 'The original deleteById must not run for a protected item.');
        }
    }

    public function testAroundDeleteByIdCallsTheOriginalAndReturnsItsResult(): void
    {
        $item = $this->createMock(ItemInterface::class);
        $item->method('getCode')->willReturn('SAMPLE');
        $this->subject->method('getById')->willReturn($item);

        $result = $this->plugin->aroundDeleteById($this->subject, fn(int $id): bool => $id === 7, 7);

        $this->assertTrue($result);
    }

    public function testAfterGetByIdUsesTheCodeWhenTheNameIsEmpty(): void
    {
        $item = $this->createMock(ItemInterface::class);
        $item->method('getName')->willReturn('');
        $item->method('getCode')->willReturn('SAMPLE');
        $item->expects($this->once())->method('setName')->with('SAMPLE');

        $this->assertSame($item, $this->plugin->afterGetById($this->subject, $item, 1));
    }
}

namespace Acme\Reference\Ui\Component\Listing\Column;

use Magento\Framework\Escaper;
use Magento\Framework\UrlInterface;
use Magento\Framework\View\Element\UiComponent\ContextInterface;
use Magento\Framework\View\Element\UiComponentFactory;
use Magento\Ui\Component\Listing\Columns\Column;

/**
 * Row actions of the grid (Edit, Delete). The actions are built here, in prepareDataSource();
 * an <item name="actions"> in the listing XML is a legacy shape that fails in this Magento version.
 *
 * Constructor: the parent's parameters (context, uiComponentFactory, components, data) in the
 * parent's order, extra dependencies before the arrays, and parent::__construct with exactly the
 * parent's parameters.
 */
class ItemActions extends Column
{
    private const URL_EDIT = 'acme_reference/item/edit';
    private const URL_DELETE = 'acme_reference/item/delete';

    /**
     * @param ContextInterface $context
     * @param UiComponentFactory $uiComponentFactory
     * @param UrlInterface $urlBuilder
     * @param Escaper $escaper
     * @param array $components
     * @param array $data
     */
    public function __construct(
        ContextInterface $context,
        UiComponentFactory $uiComponentFactory,
        private readonly UrlInterface $urlBuilder,
        private readonly Escaper $escaper,
        array $components = [],
        array $data = []
    ) {
        parent::__construct($context, $uiComponentFactory, $components, $data);
    }

    /**
     * @param array $dataSource
     * @return array
     */
    public function prepareDataSource(array $dataSource)
    {
        if (!isset($dataSource['data']['items'])) {
            return $dataSource;
        }
        $name = $this->getData('name');
        foreach ($dataSource['data']['items'] as &$item) {
            if (!isset($item['item_id'])) {
                continue;
            }
            $code = $this->escaper->escapeHtml((string)($item['code'] ?? ''));
            $item[$name]['edit'] = [
                'href' => $this->urlBuilder->getUrl(self::URL_EDIT, ['id' => $item['item_id']]),
                'label' => __('Edit'),
            ];
            $item[$name]['delete'] = [
                'href' => $this->urlBuilder->getUrl(self::URL_DELETE, ['id' => $item['item_id']]),
                'label' => __('Delete'),
                'confirm' => [
                    'title' => __('Delete %1', $code),
                    'message' => __('Are you sure you want to delete the item %1?', $code),
                ],
                'post' => true,
            ];
        }
        return $dataSource;
    }
}

/**

 */
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Reference\Ui\DataProvider;

use Acme\Reference\Controller\Adminhtml\Item\Save;
use Acme\Reference\Model\ResourceModel\Item\CollectionFactory;
use Magento\Framework\App\Request\DataPersistorInterface;
use Magento\Ui\DataProvider\Modifier\PoolInterface;
use Magento\Ui\DataProvider\ModifierPoolDataProvider;

/**
 * Data provider of the edit form (the same shape as Magento\Cms\Model\Block\DataProvider).
 *
 * Pattern:
 * - extends a REAL core class (ModifierPoolDataProvider); its constructor is name, primaryFieldName,
 *   requestFieldName, meta, data, pool - pass exactly those to parent::__construct;
 * - $collection is inherited and untyped: assign it, never redeclare it with a type (fatal);
 * - getData() returns [id => fields]; the framework already filters the collection by the request
 *   field ("id"), so only the edited item is loaded;
 * - data kept by Save after a failure (DataPersistor) is shown again.
 */
class ItemFormDataProvider extends ModifierPoolDataProvider
{
    /**
     * @var array|null
     */
    private ?array $loadedData = null;

    /**
     * @param string $name
     * @param string $primaryFieldName
     * @param string $requestFieldName
     * @param CollectionFactory $collectionFactory
     * @param DataPersistorInterface $dataPersistor
     * @param array $meta
     * @param array $data
     * @param PoolInterface|null $pool
     */
    public function __construct(
        $name,
        $primaryFieldName,
        $requestFieldName,
        CollectionFactory $collectionFactory,
        private readonly DataPersistorInterface $dataPersistor,
        array $meta = [],
        array $data = [],
        ?PoolInterface $pool = null
    ) {
        $this->collection = $collectionFactory->create();
        parent::__construct($name, $primaryFieldName, $requestFieldName, $meta, $data, $pool);
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function getData()
    {
        if ($this->loadedData !== null) {
            return $this->loadedData;
        }
        $this->loadedData = [];
        foreach ($this->collection->getItems() as $item) {
            $this->loadedData[$item->getId()] = $item->getData();
        }
        $persisted = $this->dataPersistor->get(Save::PERSISTOR_KEY);
        if (!empty($persisted)) {
            $item = $this->collection->getNewEmptyItem();
            $item->setData($persisted);
            $this->loadedData[$item->getId()] = $item->getData();
            $this->dataPersistor->clear(Save::PERSISTOR_KEY);
        }
        return $this->loadedData;
    }
}

/**

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Reference\ViewModel;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Api\SearchCriteriaBuilder;
use Magento\Framework\Serialize\Serializer\JsonHexTag;
use Magento\Framework\View\Element\Block\ArgumentInterface;

/**
 * ViewModel of the storefront template (passed as the "view_model" argument in the layout).
 *
 * Pattern: implements ArgumentInterface; holds the logic the template needs, so the template
 * only prints; JSON for x-magento-init is built with JsonHexTag (escapes < > & ' " inside a
 * <script>), which is why the template may print it with @noEscape.
 */
class ItemList implements ArgumentInterface
{
    private const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

    /**
     * @var ItemInterface[]|null
     */
    private ?array $items = null;

    /**
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     * @param SearchCriteriaBuilder $searchCriteriaBuilder
     * @param JsonHexTag $jsonHexTag
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository,
        private readonly SearchCriteriaBuilder $searchCriteriaBuilder,
        private readonly JsonHexTag $jsonHexTag
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @return ItemInterface[]
     */
    public function getItems(): array
    {
        if ($this->items === null) {
            $criteria = $this->searchCriteriaBuilder
                ->addFilter(ItemInterface::STATUS, ItemInterface::STATUS_ENABLED)
                ->setPageSize(self::PAGE_SIZE)
                ->setCurrentPage(1)
                ->create();
            $this->items = array_values($this->itemRepository->getList($criteria)->getItems());
        }
        return $this->items;
    }

    /**
     * Configuration of the JavaScript components started by the template (x-magento-init).
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function getInitJson(): string
    {
        return $this->jsonHexTag->serialize([
            '#acme-reference-items' => [
                'Acme_Reference/js/item-list' => ['highlightClass' => 'is-highlighted'],
            ],
            '*' => [
                'Magento_Ui/js/core/app' => [
                    'components' => [
                        'acmeReferenceCounter' => [
                            'component' => 'Acme_Reference/js/view/item-counter',
                            'total' => count($this->getItems()),
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * data-mage-init of each row (jQuery widget, alias declared in requirejs-config.js).
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function getToggleInitJson(): string
    {
        return $this->jsonHexTag->serialize(['acmeToggleDescription' => ['hiddenClass' => 'no-display']]);
    }
}

files.Acme/Reference/etc/events.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!--
Observers. Keep them light: react to the event, push heavy work to a queue.
- acme_reference_item_save_commit_after: dispatched by AbstractModel thanks to $_eventPrefix, AFTER
  the transaction commits (a consumer reading the row will find it; _save_after would be too early).
- sales_order_place_after: a core event.
Area: etc/events.xml = every area; etc/frontend/events.xml or etc/adminhtml/events.xml restrict it.
-->
<config xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="urn:magento:framework:Event/etc/events.xsd">
    <event name="acme_reference_item_save_commit_after">
        <observer name="acme_reference_publish_item_saved" instance="Acme\Reference\Observer\PublishItemSaved"/>
    </event>
    <event name="sales_order_place_after">
        <observer name="acme_reference_log_order_note" instance="Acme\Reference\Observer\Sales\OrderPlacedObserver"/>
    </event>
</config>
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!--
Extension attributes: add a field to a CORE data interface without changing it. Magento generates
getAcmeReferenceNote()/setAcmeReferenceNote() on the *ExtensionInterface; a plugin fills the value
(Plugin/Sales/OrderRepositoryPlugin) and the field appears in REST and GraphQL responses.
-->
<config xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="urn:magento:framework:Api/etc/extension_attributes.xsd">
    <extension_attributes for="Magento\Sales\Api\Data\OrderInterface">
        <attribute code="acme_reference_note" type="string"/>
    </extension_attributes>
    <extension_attributes for="Magento\Quote\Api\Data\AddressInterface">
        <attribute code="acme_reference_note" type="string"/>
    </extension_attributes>
</config>
